format_family.description: One of the named format families, or a new one you name.

theme.description: One sentence: the world and mood of this video.

duration_minutes.description: Chosen total duration in minutes, inside format_spec. Must equal the sum of scene durations divided by 60, rounded.

script.description: Full script when enabled, otherwise empty string.

voice_direction.description: Pace, tone, gender-neutral if unspecified; empty when disabled.

name.description: Short label, used as the chapter name.

visual_description.description: What is in frame, in renderable detail. No real people, brands, or copyrighted subjects.

motion.description: What moves and how slowly. For stills-with-motion, name the parallax, drift, or particle effect.

palette.description: 3 to 5 colour names or hex values.

transition_out.description: How this scene hands over to the next; 'end' for the last scene.

tonal_centre.description: Key or mode, e.g. 'D Dorian', 'A minor', 'drone on C'.

dynamics_over_time.description: How intensity moves across the full duration.

change.description: What enters, leaves, or shifts at this scene.

generation_prompt.description: A single prompt suitable for a music generation service or a brief to a composer. Style words only; no artist, track, or album references.

loop_safe.description: True if the piece is designed to loop seamlessly.

medium.description: e.g. painterly, photoreal-stylised, 2D flat, film grain.

negative_prompt.description: What must not appear: text, watermarks, people, logos, and anything scene-specific.

generation_prompt_prefix.description: Prefix applied to every scene's image prompt so the set looks like one piece.

variation_rationale.description: Concretely how this differs from recent_videos and what you avoided repeating.

assumptions.description: Every guess you made because the brief was silent or undecided.
